children.value: Frequently Asked Questions
What pods are compatible with Smok Novo?
Each Smok Novo generation takes its own pod.
The Smok Novo SLR 2.0 Replacement Pods fit the Smok Novo Axis and the Smok Novo Axis EZ.
The Smok Novo 2, 2X, X, 4, 5 and 6 each use a different pod; the Smok Novo Pro, Master, Eco and GT shipped with the original SLR pod.
How long should a Smok Novo pod last?
Smok publishes no figure. A 0.8ohm or 1.0ohm Smok Novo SLR 2.0 pod usually lasts
one to two weeks, or around 15 to 20ml of e-liquid
, and a 0.6ohm pod under a week. Thin 50/50 liquid, refilling at halfway and a full five-minute soak before the first draw all stretch that.
Which is better, 0.6 or 0.8 ohm?
For most Smok Novo Axis owners,
0.8ohm

. It gives a tight mouth-to-lung draw, takes 10mg or 20mg nic salts and lasts longer. Pick the 0.6ohm Smok Novo SLR 2.0 pod only if you want a warmer, looser draw with more vapour and lower nicotine, and accept faster liquid use.
Are the Smok Novo SLR 2.0 pods the same as the Smok Novo Core pods?
Yes, as far as the pod options go. Outside the UK the Smok Novo Axis pod is sold as the
Smok Novo Core Pod
in the same 0.6ohm mesh, 0.6ohm dual mesh, 0.8ohm and 1.0ohm versions; UK retailers call it the Smok Novo SLR 2.0 pod. Go by the resistance printed on the pod.
How can you tell if a Smok Novo pod is burnt?
A burnt Smok Novo SLR 2.0 pod tastes
harsh and scorched on every draw

, not just the first, and the e-liquid flavour disappears. A darkened, dry mesh seen through the pod window confirms it. It will not recover, so fit a fresh pod and let it soak for five minutes before firing.
How do you fill a Smok Novo pod?
Pull the mouthpiece cap off the Smok Novo SLR 2.0 pod.
Lift the rubber bung and fill to just below the top line.
Press the bung shut and refit the mouthpiece.
Wait at least five minutes so the mesh soaks.
Snap the pod onto the kit and take two or three short draws.
